title: DS conformance
preamble:
# DS conformance

This document defines what it means for a runtime to be
a **conforming** DS implementation. States the test
categories every runtime must pass and the pass
criteria for each. Does not enumerate individual tests
— the concrete catalogue lives runtime-side at [RCTS]
so test names and scenarios can evolve without
churning the language spec.

Paired with:

- [LDET] — the foundational
  guarantee the conformance suite verifies.
- [LTES] — the author-facing testing
  contract that every runtime must deliver.
- [RCTS] — the enumerated test catalogue the reference
  runtime publishes.

## What this is not

- Not the enumeration of tests. That lives in
  [RCTS]
  where test names, scenarios, and pass outputs can
  be versioned alongside the reference runtime.
- Not a test harness spec. Harness contracts live in
  [LTES] and
  [RTIM].
- Not a performance benchmark. Conformance is about
  correctness, not speed.
